security: TsAuth project access JWT; project_id binding and database narrowing
parameters: required canonical ULID project path; optional existing region pin; no query/body
pagination: none; fixed last hour, rates over last five complete UTC minutes
retry: SDK sends once; no idempotency or checkpoint contract
observations: best effort, flushed every 10 seconds; never billing truth
fixtureKind: synthetic text derived from producer Format/Family/Line, not live evidence
